title: Educating First-time Home Buyers or Sellers on Non-exclusive Agreements
what_it_is: Educating First-time Home Buyers or Sellers on Non-exclusive Agreements

sections.label: Estate agency agreement rules
sections.summary: CEA's code requires property agents to explain agreements to clients, with penalties for failure, and CEA educates consumers on exclusive and non-exclusive agreements.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Under the Council for Estate Agencies (CEA)'s Code of Ethics and Professional Client Care, a property agent must explain the meaning and consequences of the agreement to the client and give the client sufficient time to read and understand the content, so that the client can make an informed decision whether to enter into the agreement with the agent.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Property agents who fail to do so may be issued a warning letter, imposed with financial penalties of up to $100,000 and/or have their registration suspended or revoked.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: There is no specific requirement for a property agent to advise the client on the options between an exclusive and a non-exclusive agreement.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: CEA continues to work with relevant agencies, for example, HDB and CASE, and the real estate agency sector and online property portals to educate property consumers about the purpose of signing an estate agency agreement, the differences between an exclusive and a non-exclusive agreement, and consumers' obligations under each type of agreement.

sections.label: Signing agreements and complaints
sections.summary: Signing estate agency agreements is encouraged but not mandatory, agents must explain content, and complaints on exclusive or non-exclusive agreements are under 1%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Consumers are encouraged to sign the agreement with their property agencies and agents to protect the interests of both parties, but it is not mandatory.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: To Dr Tan Wu Meng's question about best practices and informed consent, CEA takes seriously, its responsibility in upholding the professional standards in the real estate agency industry and its primary responsibility of safeguarding consumers' interests.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: That is why I mentioned in my reply earlier, that an estate agent or the real estate salesperson, the technical term, is expected and required to explain the content of the agreement to the buyer or seller before the agreement is signed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: A breach of that can be investigated and penalties can be imposed against the real estate agent.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: On consumer awareness, I mentioned it earlier, but allow me to elaborate and set in context Dr Tan's case about his resident.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: I appreciate and empathise where Dr Tan is coming from, but in context, we have received very, very few complaints against real estate salesperson on the use of an exclusive or non-exclusive agreement – less than 1% of all the cases we received over the last five years.
